What was the topic of the last lesson? What did you learn?
(Worship)

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
God has called all His children to do His work. He can use anyone to do anything. Today, we will learn that we are all called and able to do His work.
1 Peter 2:9
John 4:1-42 (The Samaritan Woman)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
All who follow Jesus are equal. This means that He does His work through all of us.
Because of the testimony of an uneducated, poor, sinful woman, many people came to know Him.
We are all equal in Christ, and we are all equipped to do God’s work.
Jesus knows everything.
We should worship God in spirit and in truth.
He can use anyone to do anything.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Read Part 2 of this lesson and practice sharing your testimony in groups of two.
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell your testimony and Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
God deserves for His glory to be known among all people and places. Let’s commit to tell of His glory with all people.
Habakkuk 2:14
Pray
Ask God to give us confidence in Him to do His work. Ask Him to use each of us to make His name great throughout this place.
